name: Civil unrest
summary: Unrest continues in Rawalakot, Pakistani Kashmir, after a 5 Nov crackdown; deaths disputed; no nationwide unrest found
state: Unrest continued in Rawalakot, Pakistan-administered Kashmir, after security forces cleared protest camps on 5 Nov; protest leaders report several deaths that authorities have not confirmed, and AJK Police said a Rangers officer died on 8 Nov of injuries from that day (Express Tribune, 9 Nov). Searches on 12 Nov found no nationwide deadly unrest or crackdown in a major country, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Most directly affects residents of Rawalakot and nearby districts, where shutdowns and clashes disrupt travel and services. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for Pakistan.
rubric_hit: Watch: deadly unrest in one country (Pakistan-administered Kashmir); no nationwide deadly unrest in a major country (Alert line)

sources.title: Express Tribune — TTAP calls for immediate end to violence, resumption of talks to quell AJK unrest

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
